title: xdrip unresponsive + high batterie drain on watch + missed readings
body:
Somehow since Januar several peaple observe:
- xdrip app unresponsive, app blocks for a few seconds and we either need to wait a bit or kill app
- Often missed reading (Blukon)
- High batterie drain on wear smartwatch (Huawei version 1, wear 2.0)

By disabling wear integration no more problem!

Remarks from:

@luckyLuke: Hey anyone experiencing xdrip+ hangs lately? Ever since the januari nightlies I occasionally see hangs of the app. Sometimes even when I change an alarm it hangs for a few seconds, if I do a restart collector I have even seen it hang till I got the unresponsive message and had to close the app? Still have an old galaxy S4, will replace it soon...
Seems like the hanging is caused by enabling android wear integration. Something must have been added that causes a blocking operation... I've disabled it and am using my own notification listener to transmit the glucose values to my android wear complication.

@FPV-UAV:
 with my TransmiterPL (its pure Limitter protocol) some users informed me so they has troubles with reconnection when go out of ranger of Bluetooth and return. Solution was in downgrade xDrip to before 01.01.2018 version. Most stable are version from November - ea 13.11.2017.

from my tests: problems with reconnection (but not at all version of phones / androids) started when body sensors was added to Smartwatch functions. For xDrip with only 2 functions (integration with Android Wear and with Pebble) - no such behaviour.
and - never received such info from users with Android versions lower than 6.0

@jamorham let us know what you need to better understand issue
Logs?
Tests?

Thanks
@gregorybel

comments.body: I found one thing: I deleted wear app and reinstalled it, no more batterie drain issue!
